1: //! Deterministic lighting and camera presets for sky captures.
2: 
3: use super::*;
4: 
5: pub(super) fn sky_view_configuration(view: SkyView) -> SkyViewConfiguration {
6:     let absolute_minute = match view {
7:         SkyView::Sun => StrategicMinute::day_start_for_index(172).saturating_add_minutes(12 * 60),
8:         // Clear midsummer low Sun: demonstrates atmospheric extinction and
9:         // aureole structure without changing the production solar model.
10:         SkyView::SunDetail => {
11:             StrategicMinute::day_start_for_index(172).saturating_add_minutes(19 * 60)
12:         }
13:         SkyView::Twilight => {
14:             StrategicMinute::day_start_for_index(80).saturating_add_minutes(18 * 60)
15:         }
16:         // Day 249 23:00: verified moonlit slot, +24.6 degrees and 99% illuminated.
17:         SkyView::Moon => StrategicMinute::new(359_940),
18:         // Canonical new moon at 23:00 on day 77.
19:         SkyView::Stars => StrategicMinute::new(637_860),
20:         SkyView::CloudCumulus
21:         | SkyView::CloudStratocumulus
22:         | SkyView::CloudCirrus
23:         | SkyView::CloudOvercast
24:         | SkyView::CloudStorm => {
25:             StrategicMinute::day_start_for_index(172).saturating_add_minutes(15 * 60)
26:         }
27:     };
28:     let celestial = celestial_directions(absolute_minute, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE);
29:     let sun = to_bevy_direction(celestial.sun);
30:     let moon = to_bevy_direction(celestial.moon);
31:     let view_direction = match view {
32:         SkyView::Sun => horizon_view(sun, 0.5),
33:         SkyView::SunDetail => sun,
34:         SkyView::Twilight => horizon_view(sun, 0.03),
35:         SkyView::Moon => moon,
36:         SkyView::Stars => Vec3::new(0.15, 0.55, -0.82).normalize(),
37:         SkyView::CloudCumulus
38:         | SkyView::CloudStratocumulus
39:         | SkyView::CloudCirrus
40:         | SkyView::CloudOvercast
41:         | SkyView::CloudStorm => horizon_view(sun, 0.34),
42:     };
43:     SkyViewConfiguration {
44:         absolute_minute,
45:         sun_altitude_degrees: celestial.sun[1].asin().to_degrees(),
46:         moon_altitude_degrees: celestial.moon[1].asin().to_degrees(),
47:         lunar_illumination: celestial.lunar_illumination,
48:         camera_translation: Vec3::new(0.0, 2.0, 8.0),
49:         camera_direction: view_direction,
50:         vertical_fov_degrees: if matches!(view, SkyView::Moon) {
51:             12.0
52:         } else if matches!(view, SkyView::SunDetail) {
53:             20.0
54:         } else if is_cloud_view(view) {
55:             72.0
56:         } else {
57:             80.0
58:         },
59:     }
60: }

45: fn focus_requirements_met(
46:     focus: Option<&str>,
47:     visible_names: &[String],
48:     focused_tower_count: usize,
49: ) -> bool {
50:     let count = |needle: &str| {
51:         visible_names
52:             .iter()
53:             .filter(|name| name.contains(needle))
54:             .count()
55:     };
56:     match focus {
57:         Some("gate_exterior") => {
58:             focused_tower_count >= 2
59:                 && count("round tower shell with open firing loops") >= 2
60:                 && count("closed heavy gate leaf") >= 2
61:                 && count("portcullis vertical bar") >= 2
62:                 && count("gate guard chamber") >= 4
63:                 && count("outward firing opening") >= 1
64:         }
65:         Some("gate_interior_section") => {
66:             count("closed heavy gate leaf") >= 2
67:                 && count("portcullis vertical bar") >= 2
68:                 && count("gate guard chamber floor") >= 1
69:                 && count("gate guard chamber access stair") >= 5
70:                 && count("gate access top landing") >= 1
71:                 && count("gate access bottom landing") >= 1
72:                 && count("gate access support post") >= 4
73:                 && count("gate access continuous edge guard") >= 4
74:                 && count("gate access landing perimeter guard") >= 4
75:                 && count("gate access masonry wall ledger") >= 1
76:                 && count("gate access diagonal lateral brace") >= 6
77:                 && count("floor-level guard chamber door") >= 1
78:                 && count("floor around downward opening") >= 1
79:                 && count("portcullis operating windlass") >= 1
80:         }
81:         Some("tower_portal") => {
82:             focused_tower_count == 1
83:                 && count("tower entrance jamb") >= 2
84:                 && count("portal landing") >= 1
85:                 && count("spiral stair tread") >= 5
86:                 && count("tower-top deck") >= 1
87:         }
88:         Some("resolved_crown") => {
89:             count("Breastwork") >= 1
90:                 && count("Merlon") >= 1
91:                 && count("Coping") >= 1
92:                 && count("EdgeGuard") >= 1
93:         }
94:         Some("resolved_projected") => {
95:             count("GalleryFloor")
96:                 + count("ProjectionSupport")
97:                 + count("FrameMember")
98:                 + count("BartizanShell")
99:                 + count("DefenseHostWall")
100:                 + count("CircuitWalk")
101:                 + count("BeamJoist")
102:                 + count("DrainageFloor")
103:                 >= 3
104:         }
105:         Some("resolved_roof") => count("resolved roof") >= 1,
106:         Some("resolved_opening") => count("OpeningJamb") >= 1 && count("OpeningHead") >= 1,
107:         Some("resolved_wall_section") => {
108:             count("WallHost") >= 1 || count("architectural section") >= 3
109:         }

111:         // church proofs.  An isolated two-pier bay or two-beam bell frame can
112:         // intentionally contain fewer than eight `Church*` meshes.

118:                 + count("FrameRail")

33:                 RoofMaterial::Slate | RoofMaterial::Lead => &palette.roof_secondary,
34:                 RoofMaterial::TimberInfill => &palette.plaster,
35:                 RoofMaterial::MasonryInfill | RoofMaterial::RubbleInfill => &palette.stone,

49:                 local_center: (bounds.0 + bounds.1) * 0.5,
50:                 local_half_size: (bounds.1 - bounds.0) * 0.5,
51:             },

204: fn spawn_box(
205:     world: &mut World,
206:     material: &Handle<StandardMaterial>,
207:     size: Vec3,
208:     translation: Vec3,
209:     rotation: Quat,
210:     name: &'static str,
211: ) -> Entity {
212:     let mesh = world
213:         .resource_mut::<Assets<Mesh>>()
214:         .add(Cuboid::new(size.x, size.y, size.z));
215:     let entity = world
216:         .spawn((
217:             Name::new(name),
218:             ClosedSolid,
219:             Mesh3d(mesh),
220:             MeshMaterial3d(material.clone()),
221:             Transform {
222:                 translation,
223:                 rotation,
224:                 ..default()
225:             },
226:         ))
227:         .id();
228:     tag_player_build_entity(world, entity, material);
229:     if world.get_resource::<PlayerBuildSpawnContext>().is_some() {
230:         let half = size * 0.5;
231:         let axes = [rotation * Vec3::X, rotation * Vec3::Y, rotation * Vec3::Z];
232:         let extent = Vec3::new(
233:             half.x * axes[0].x.abs() + half.y * axes[1].x.abs() + half.z * axes[2].x.abs(),
234:             half.x * axes[0].y.abs() + half.y * axes[1].y.abs() + half.z * axes[2].y.abs(),
235:             half.x * axes[0].z.abs() + half.y * axes[1].z.abs() + half.z * axes[2].z.abs(),
236:         );
237:         world.entity_mut(entity).insert(PlayerBuildRenderPrism {
238:             min: translation - extent,
239:             max: translation + extent,
240:         });
241:     }
242:     entity
243: }

245: fn tag_player_build_entity(world: &mut World, entity: Entity, material: &Handle<StandardMaterial>) {
246:     if let Some(context) = world.get_resource::<PlayerBuildSpawnContext>().copied() {
247:         world.entity_mut(entity).insert((
248:             PlayerBuildEntity,
249:             EditorVisibilityTarget {
250:                 storey: context.storey,
251:                 role: context.role,
252:             },
253:             EditorBaseMaterial(material.clone()),
254:             EditorAppearanceIsTranslucent(false),
255:             Visibility::Visible,
256:         ));
257:     }
258: }

219: fn validate_projected_suite_records(
220:     records: &[(&str, ProjectedSuiteManifest)],
221: ) -> Result<(), String> {
222:     if records.len() != PROJECTED_PROOF_SUITE.len() {
223:         return Err(format!(
224:             "expected {} projected-defense manifests, found {}",
225:             PROJECTED_PROOF_SUITE.len(),
226:             records.len()
227:         ));
228:     }
229:     let first = &records[0].1;
230:     let mut fixtures = std::collections::HashMap::<(&str, Seed), (&str, &str)>::new();
231:     for ((actual_name, manifest), expected) in records.iter().zip(PROJECTED_PROOF_SUITE) {
232:         if *actual_name != expected.basename
233:             || manifest.fixture != expected.fixture
234:             || manifest.view != expected.view
235:             || manifest.seed != expected.seed
236:             || manifest.projected_defense_kind.as_deref() != expected.kind
237:             || manifest.projected_defense_deployment.as_deref() != expected.deployment
238:         {
239:             return Err(format!(
240:                 "projected proof {actual_name} does not match its expected fixture/view/seed/state"
241:             ));
242:         }
243:         if !manifest.validation_passed || manifest.resolver_schema_version != 2 {
244:             return Err(format!(
245:                 "projected proof {actual_name} is invalid or not resolver schema 2"
246:             ));
247:         }
248:         if manifest.source_revision != first.source_revision
249:             || manifest.source_dirty_fingerprint != first.source_dirty_fingerprint
250:         {
251:             return Err(format!(
252:                 "projected proof {actual_name} comes from a mixed source build"
253:             ));
254:         }
255:         if expected.kind.is_some()
256:             && (manifest.focus_kind.as_deref() != Some("resolved_projected")
257:                 || manifest.focused_resolved_item_ids.is_empty()
258:                 || manifest.focused_resolved_void_ids.is_empty()
259:                     && expected.deployment != Some("sockets_only")
260:                 || manifest.focused_projected_ray_count == 0
261:                     && expected.deployment != Some("sockets_only")
262:                 || manifest.projected_tactical_target.is_none())
263:         {
264:             return Err(format!(
265:                 "projected proof {actual_name} lacks exact assembly IDs, voids, rays, or tactical target"
266:             ));
267:         }
268:         let fixture_key = (expected.fixture, expected.seed);
269:         if let Some((plan_hash, resolved_hash)) = fixtures.get(&fixture_key) {
270:             if *plan_hash != manifest.plan_hash || *resolved_hash != manifest.resolved_geometry_hash
271:             {
272:                 return Err(format!(
273:                     "projected proof {actual_name} disagrees with its fixture/seed hashes"
274:                 ));
275:             }
276:         } else {
277:             fixtures.insert(
278:                 fixture_key,
279:                 (&manifest.plan_hash, &manifest.resolved_geometry_hash),
280:             );
281:         }
282:     }
283:     Ok(())
284: }

286: pub(crate) fn validate_projected_suite(directory: &std::path::Path) -> Result<(), String> {
287:     let mut owned = Vec::with_capacity(PROJECTED_PROOF_SUITE.len());
288:     for expected in PROJECTED_PROOF_SUITE {
289:         let path = directory.join(format!("{}.capture.json", expected.basename));
290:         let bytes = fs::read(&path).map_err(|error| format!("read {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
291:         let manifest = serde_json::from_slice::<ProjectedSuiteManifest>(&bytes)
292:             .map_err(|error| format!("parse {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
293:         owned.push((expected.basename, manifest));
294:     }
295:     validate_projected_suite_records(&owned)
296: }

141:             || !manifest

144:                 .all(|id| manifest.church_target_item_ids.contains(id))
145:             || manifest.church_removed_target_item_ids

595: ) -> Option<&adventuresim_building_generator::ProjectedDefenseAssembly> {
596:     use adventuresim_building_generator::ProjectedDefenseDeployment;
597:     plan.projected_defenses.iter().find(|defense| {
598:         projected_kind_matches(defense, kind)
599:             && if view == ViewerView::ProjectedSockets {
600:                 defense.deployment == ProjectedDefenseDeployment::SocketsOnly

66: impl ReviewRequirements {

68:         for building in buildings {
69:             if !adventuresim_building_generator::audit_plan(&building.plan)?.is_empty() {

71:                     "review building {} fails the structural audit",
72:                     building.placement.id

78:             buildings: buildings.len(),
79:             boundaries: 0,
80:             doors: buildings
81:                 .iter()
82:                 .map(|b| compile_operable_doors(&b.plan).map(|doors| doors.len()))
83:                 .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?
84:                 .into_iter()
85:                 .sum(),
86:             windows: buildings
87:                 .iter()
88:                 .map(|b| compile_operable_windows(&b.plan).map(|windows| windows.len()))
89:                 .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?
90:                 .into_iter()
91:                 .sum(),

108: pub(super) fn setup(
109:     commands: &mut Commands,
110:     buildings: &[GeneratedBuilding],
111:     boundaries: usize,
112:     input: &Path,
113:     output: &Path,
114:     profile: &str,
115: ) -> Result<Option<Vec<BuildingReviewCamera>>> {
116:     if !is_profile(profile) {
117:         return Ok(None);
118:     }
119:     let path = input.with_extension("review.json");
120:     let bytes = std::fs::read(&path)?;
121:     let fixture: ReviewFixture = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)?;
122:     let specs =
123:         super::selected_capture_views(profile, &[]).map_err(bevy::ecs::error::BevyError::from)?;
124:     assert_eq!(
125:         fixture.views.len(),
126:         specs.len() - 1,
127:         "fixture must cover every review view"
128:     );
129:     for (view, spec) in fixture.views.iter().zip(&specs[1..]) {
130:         assert_eq!(view.slug, spec.slug);
131:     }
132:     let mut requirements = ReviewRequirements::for_buildings(buildings, output)?;
133:     requirements.boundaries = boundaries;
134:     requirements.doors += boundaries;
135:     for (&id, sign) in &fixture.signs {
136:         let building = buildings
137:             .iter()
138:             .find(|b| b.placement.id == id)
139:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("review sign building {id} is absent"))?;
140:         assert!(
141:             building
142:                 .placement
143:                 .program
144:                 .usage
145:                 .and_then(adventuresim_building_generator::signs::shop_trade)
146:                 .is_some(),
147:             "sign requires a public shopfront"
148:         );
149:         let site = SignSite::for_plan(&building.plan)
150:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("review sign building {id} lacks structural support"))?;
151:         assert!(
152:             site.supports(&building.plan, sign.mount),
153:             "review sign must fit its specified mount"
154:         );
155:         requirements.signs.insert(
156:             id,
157:             ExpectedSign {
158:                 sign: sign.clone(),
159:                 site,
160:             },
161:         );
162:     }
163:     let cameras = fixture
164:         .views
165:         .iter()
166:         .map(|view| view.camera(buildings, &fixture.signs))
167:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
168:     std::fs::write(output.join("input.review.json"), bytes)?;
169:     commands.insert_resource(requirements);
170:     commands.insert_resource(fixture);
171:     Ok(Some(cameras))
172: }

1: //! Melee-only iteration roster assembled from canonical character and item data.
2: 
3: use super::*;
4: use crate::{
5:     item_catalog_schema::ItemKind,
6:     starting_character::{StartingAttributes, StartingCharacterSpec, StartingSkills},
7: };
8: use adventuresim_world_schema::{Culture, person_names::PersonalNameIdentity};
9: 
10: pub use error::{MeleeIterationError, MeleeIterationResult};
11: pub use evidence::*;
12: 
13: mod error;
14: mod evidence;
15: 
16: #[derive(Clone, Debug)]
17: pub struct MeleeIterationBuild {
18:     pub key: &'static str,
19:     pub name: String,
20:     pub description: &'static str,
21:     pub equipment_description: &'static str,
22:     pub weapon_id: &'static str,
23:     pub armor_ids: Vec<&'static str>,
24:     pub shield_id: Option<&'static str>,
25:     pub combatant: Combatant,
26: }
27: 
28: pub fn melee_iteration_roster()
29: -> MeleeIterationResult<(MeleeIterationBuild, Vec<MeleeIterationBuild>)> {
30:     let john_spec = crate::starting_character::default_character("melee-iteration");
31:     let john_name = john_spec.native_everyday_name()?.into_string();
32:     let john = build_from_spec(
33:         "john",
34:         &john_name,
35:         "Combat-trained adventurer; strong and agile, with broadly advanced melee training.",
36:         "Longsword, morion, breastplate, paired steel vambraces, ordinary clothing and boots.",
37:         &john_spec,
38:         "longsword",
39:         &["morion", "breastplate", "vambrace", "vambrace"],
40:         None,
41:     )?;
42:     let mut hammer_brute = purpose_build(
43:         "hammer_brute",
44:         "Hammer Brute",
45:         4.5,
46:         2.25,
47:         "war_hammer",
48:         &["brigandine", "arming_cap"],
49:         None,
50:         "Exceptionally strong but only moderately agile fighter with competent hammer training.",
51:         "War hammer, brigandine, and arming cap.",
52:     )?;
53:     hammer_brute.combatant.attributes.instinct = 3.0;
54:     hammer_brute.combatant.attributes.left_arm_agility = 3.0;
55:     hammer_brute.combatant.attributes.right_arm_agility = 3.0;
56:     hammer_brute.combatant.attributes.left_leg_agility = 3.0;
57:     hammer_brute.combatant.attributes.right_leg_agility = 3.0;
58:     let opponents = vec![
59:         purpose_build(
60:             "militia",
61:             "Shield Militiaman",
62:             3.0,
63:             2.5,
64:             "arming_sword",
65:             &["arming_doublet", "arming_cap"],
66:             Some("buckler"),
67:             "Healthy adult militia fighter with competent sword, shield, dodge, and balance training.",
68:             "Arming sword and buckler over an arming doublet and cap.",
69:         )?,
70:         purpose_build(
71:             "demi_lancer",
72:             "Demi-lancer",
73:             3.5,
74:             3.25,
75:             "arming_sword",
76:             &["morion", "cuirass", "tassets", "vambrace", "vambrace"],
77:             None,
78:             "Fit professional mounted soldier fighting on foot, with advanced sword, defense, and balance training.",
79:             "Arming sword and demi-lancer steel plate armor.",
80:         )?,
81:         purpose_build(
82:             "polearm_veteran",
83:             "Polearm Veteran",
84:             3.5,
85:             4.0,
86:             "halberd",
87:             &["jack_of_plates", "sallet"],
88:             None,
89:             "Seasoned professional with expert polearm skill, strong balance, and advanced defensive training.",
90:             "Halberd, jack of plates, and sallet.",
91:         )?,
92:         hammer_brute,
93:         purpose_build(
94:             "knife_novice",
95:             "Knife Novice",
96:             2.5,
97:             1.0,
98:             "baselard",
99:             &["arming_doublet"],
100:             None,
101:             "Below-average novice with rudimentary knife, dodge, block, will, and balance training.",
102:             "Baselard and an arming doublet.",
103:         )?,
104:     ];
105:     Ok((john, opponents))
106: }
107: 
108: #[expect(
109:     clippy::too_many_arguments,
110:     reason = "fixture construction keeps reviewer context with its build"
111: )]
112: fn purpose_build(
113:     key: &'static str,
114:     name: &'static str,
115:     physical: f32,
116:     skill_rank: f32,
117:     weapon: &'static str,
118:     armor: &[&'static str],
119:     shield: Option<&'static str>,
120:     description: &'static str,
121:     equipment_description: &'static str,
122: ) -> MeleeIterationResult<MeleeIterationBuild> {
123:     let hours = Skill::Sword.hours_for_rank(skill_rank);
124:     let attributes = StartingAttributes {
125:         endurance: physical,
126:         immunity: physical,
127:         gut: physical,
128:         intelligence: 3.0,
129:         instinct: physical,
130:         eyesight: 3.0,
131:         hearing: 3.0,
132:         strength: physical,
133:         agility: physical,
134:     };
135:     let skills = StartingSkills {
136:         sword: hours,
137:         polearm: hours,
138:         bludgeon: hours,
139:         knife: hours,
140:         dodge: hours,
141:         block: hours,
142:         will: hours,
143:         balance: hours,
144:         ..StartingSkills::default()
145:     };
146:     let spec = StartingCharacterSpec {
147:         id: stable_id(key),
148:         name_identity: PersonalNameIdentity::authored(name, Culture::German),
149:         age_years: 28,
150:         background: description.into(),
151:         personality: crate::starting_character::default_character(key).personality,
152:         attributes,
153:         skills,
154:         currency: 0,
155:         settlement_selector: fabelgeist_determinism::Seed::from_u64(0),
156:         inventory: Vec::new(),
157:         age_tier: crate::starting_character::StartingAgeTier::Adult,
158:         profession: None,
159:         organization: None,
160:         religion_id: None,
161:     };
162:     build_from_spec(
163:         key,
164:         name,
165:         description,
166:         equipment_description,
167:         &spec,
168:         weapon,
169:         armor,
170:         shield,
171:     )
172: }
173: 
174: fn stable_id(value: &str) -> u64 {
175:     value.bytes().fold(0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325, |hash, byte| {
176:         (hash ^ u64::from(byte)).wrapping_mul(0x100_0000_01b3)
177:     })
178: }
179: 
180: #[expect(
181:     clippy::too_many_arguments,
182:     reason = "fixture construction names combat and reviewer context"
183: )]
184: fn build_from_spec(
185:     key: &'static str,
186:     name: &str,
187:     description: &'static str,
188:     equipment_description: &'static str,
189:     spec: &StartingCharacterSpec,
190:     weapon_id: &'static str,
191:     armor_ids: &[&'static str],
192:     shield_id: Option<&'static str>,
193: ) -> MeleeIterationResult<MeleeIterationBuild> {
194:     let a = &spec.attributes;
195:     let mut combatant = Combatant::new(spec.id);
196:     combatant.attributes = PlayerAttributeValues {
197:         endurance: a.endurance,
198:         immunity: a.immunity,
199:         gut: a.gut,
200:         intelligence: a.intelligence,
201:         instinct: a.instinct,
202:         eyesight: a.eyesight,
203:         hearing: a.hearing,
204:         left_arm_strength: a.strength,
205:         right_arm_strength: a.strength,
206:         left_leg_strength: a.strength,
207:         right_leg_strength: a.strength,
208:         left_arm_agility: a.agility,
209:         right_arm_agility: a.agility,
210:         left_leg_agility: a.agility,
211:         right_leg_agility: a.agility,
212:     };
213:     combatant.skills = combat_skills(&spec.skills);
214:     combatant.body.weight_kg = 75.0;
215:     combatant.equipment = authored_equipment(weapon_id, armor_ids, shield_id)?;
216:     Ok(MeleeIterationBuild {
217:         key,
218:         name: name.to_owned(),
219:         description,
220:         equipment_description,
221:         weapon_id,
222:         armor_ids: armor_ids.to_vec(),
223:         shield_id,
224:         combatant,
225:     })
226: }
227: 
257: fn authored_equipment(
258:     weapon_id: &str,
259:     armor_ids: &[&str],
260:     shield_id: Option<&str>,
261: ) -> MeleeIterationResult<CombatEquipment> {
262:     let definition = crate::item_catalog::definition(weapon_id).ok_or_else(|| {
263:         MeleeIterationError::UnknownWeapon {
264:             weapon: weapon_id.to_owned(),
265:         }
266:     })?;
267:     let weapon = CombatWeapon::from_authored_melee_definition(definition)?;
268:     let mut equipment = CombatEquipment {
269:         weapon: Some(weapon),
270:         melee_weapon: Some(weapon),
271:         melee_weapon_id: Some(stable_id(weapon_id)),
272:         inventory_weight: definition.weight_kg,
273:         ..CombatEquipment::default()
274:     };
275:     if let Some(shield_id) = shield_id {
276:         let shield = crate::item_catalog::definition(shield_id).ok_or_else(|| {
277:             MeleeIterationError::UnknownShield {
278:                 shield: shield_id.to_owned(),
279:             }
280:         })?;
281:         let ItemKind::Shield { block, .. } = shield.kind else {
282:             return Err(MeleeIterationError::NotShield {
283:                 shield: shield_id.to_owned(),
284:             });
285:         };
286:         equipment.shield_block_bonus = block;
287:         equipment.shield_side = Some(match equipment.melee_holding_side {
288:             BodySide::Left => BodySide::Right,
289:             BodySide::Right => BodySide::Left,
290:             BodySide::Both => BodySide::Left,
291:         });
292:         equipment.defense_item_id = Some(stable_id(shield_id));
293:         equipment.inventory_weight += shield.weight_kg;
294:     }
295:     apply_authored_armor(&mut equipment, armor_ids)?;
296:     Ok(equipment)
297: }

1: //! Portable geometry admission and arithmetic failures.
2: 
3: /// Checked spatial construction and measurement operations.
4: pub type GeometryResult<T> = std::result::Result<T, GeometryError>;
5: 
6: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, serde::Serialize)]
7: #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
8: pub enum CoordinateAxis {
9:     X,
10:     Y,
11:     Z,
12: }
13: 
14: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq, serde::Serialize)]
15: #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
16: pub enum GeometryRole {
17:     SignedLength,
18:     Area,
19:     Position,
20:     Displacement,
21:     Elevation,
22:     CuboidDimensions,
23:     LeafDimensions,
24:     PlanDimensions,
25:     PlanExtents,
26:     Angle,
27:     BoundsCentre,
28:     BoundsExtent,
29:     Direction,
30:     SweepRadius,
31:     FloorWidth,
32:     FloorSpan,
33:     FloorStation,
34:     ClearanceVolume,
35:     PositiveLength,
36: }
37: 
38: /// Portable failure of native direction admission. Classification occurs once
39: /// in the framework adapter; consumers retain its typed cause.
40: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, thiserror::Error)]
41: pub enum DirectionError {
42:     #[error("The length of the direction vector is zero or very close to zero")]
43:     Zero,
44:     #[error("The length of the direction vector is `std::f32::INFINITY`")]
45:     Infinite,
46:     #[error("The length of the direction vector is `NaN`")]
47:     NaN,
48: }
49: 
50: #[derive(Clone, Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize)]
51: pub enum GeometryError {
52:     #[error("spatial index partition is empty")]
53:     EmptySpatialPartition,
54:     #[error("rotation must be finite and normalized")]
55:     InvalidRotation,
56:     #[error("invalid rigid frame projection")]
57:     InvalidProjection,
58:     #[error("{role:?} has a nonfinite {axis:?} component")]
59:     NonFinite {
60:         role: GeometryRole,
61:         axis: CoordinateAxis,
62:     },
63:     #[error("{role:?} has a negative {axis:?} extent")]
64:     NegativeExtent {
65:         role: GeometryRole,

132: fn defensive_implement_kind(
133:     event: &MeleeAttackResolved,
134:     viewer: &TacticalPlayerViewer<'_, '_>,

136:     let slot = event.defender_blocking_slot?;
137:     let defender = viewer.get(event.target).ok()?;
138:     let side_slot = |side| match side {
139:         BodySide::Left => Some(EquipSlot::HoldingLeft),
140:         BodySide::Right => Some(EquipSlot::HoldingRight),
141:         BodySide::Both => None,
142:     };
143:     if defender.shield_holding_side().and_then(side_slot) == Some(slot) {
144:         Some(TacticalDefenseImplement::Shield)
145:     } else if defender.weapon_holding_side().and_then(side_slot) == Some(slot) {
146:         Some(TacticalDefenseImplement::Weapon)
147:     } else {
148:         Some(TacticalDefenseImplement::Other)
149:     }

518: fn apply_selected_book(
519:     skills: &mut CharacterSkills,
520:     book: &adventuresim_core::item_catalog_schema::Book,
521:     real_hours: f32,
522:     attributes: &CharacterAttributes,
523: ) -> Result<adventuresim_core::book::BoundedBookGain, String> {
524:     use adventuresim_core::item_catalog_schema::BookTarget;
525:     let medium_rank = adventuresim_core::book::written_rank(
526:         skills.written_languages.effective(book.medium),
527:         attributes.intelligence,
528:     );
529:     let (rank, aptitude) = target_snapshot(skills, &book.target, attributes)
530:         .ok_or("Book catalog contains an unsupported training target")?;
531:     let (lower, upper) = adventuresim_core::book::rank_band(book);
532:     match &book.target {
533:         BookTarget::Written { language } => {
534:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_written_book_training(
535:                 &mut skills.written_languages,
536:                 book.medium,
537:                 *language,
538:                 rank,
539:                 attributes.intelligence,
540:                 lower,
541:                 upper,
542:                 real_hours,
543:             ))
544:         }
545:         BookTarget::Religion { religion } => {
546:             let baseline = skills.religion_hours;
547:             let direct = skills.religion_hours.direct_mut(*religion);
548:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_bounded_book_training(
549:                 direct,
550:                 rank,
551:                 aptitude,
552:                 lower,
553:                 upper,
554:                 real_hours,
555:                 medium_rank,
556:                 |rank| Skill::Religion.hours_for_rank(rank),
557:                 |candidate| {
558:                     let mut projected = baseline;
559:                     *projected.direct_mut(*religion) = candidate;
560:                     projected.effective(*religion)
561:                 },
562:             ))
563:         }
564:         BookTarget::Bestiary { category } => {
565:             let baseline = skills.bestiary_hours;
566:             let direct = skills.bestiary_hours.direct_mut(*category);
567:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_bounded_book_training(
568:                 direct,
569:                 rank,
570:                 aptitude,
571:                 lower,
572:                 upper,
573:                 real_hours,
574:                 medium_rank,
575:                 |rank| Skill::Bestiary.hours_for_rank(rank),
576:                 |candidate| {
577:                     let mut projected = baseline;
578:                     *projected.direct_mut(*category) = candidate;
579:                     projected.effective(*category)
580:                 },
581:             ))
582:         }
583:         BookTarget::Terrain { terrain } => {
584:             let skill = terrain_book_skill(terrain)
585:                 .ok_or("Book catalog contains an unsupported terrain target")?;
586:             let transferred = skill
587:                 .ordinary_correlations()
588:                 .iter()
589:                 .map(|(source, coefficient)| {
590:                     skills.skill_hours_trained(*source).max(0.0) * coefficient
591:                 })
592:                 .sum::<f32>()
593:                 .max(0.0);
594:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_bounded_book_training(
595:                 direct_skill_hours_mut(skills, skill),
596:                 rank,
597:                 aptitude,
598:                 lower,
599:                 upper,
600:                 real_hours,
601:                 medium_rank,
602:                 |rank| skill.hours_for_rank(rank),
603:                 |candidate| candidate.max(0.0) + transferred,
604:             ))
605:         }
606:         BookTarget::Skill { .. } => {
607:             let skill = adventuresim_core::book::ordinary_skill(&book.target)
608:                 .ok_or("Book catalog contains an unsupported skill target")?;
609:             let transferred = skill
610:                 .ordinary_correlations()
611:                 .iter()
612:                 .map(|(source, coefficient)| {
613:                     skills.skill_hours_trained(*source).max(0.0) * coefficient
614:                 })
615:                 .sum::<f32>()
616:                 .max(0.0);
617:             Ok(adventuresim_core::book::apply_bounded_book_training(
618:                 direct_skill_hours_mut(skills, skill),
619:                 rank,
620:                 aptitude,
621:                 lower,
622:                 upper,
623:                 real_hours,
624:                 medium_rank,
625:                 |rank| skill.hours_for_rank(rank),
626:                 |candidate| {
627:                     let candidate = candidate.max(0.0);
628:                     if skill.is_trained() && candidate <= 0.0 {
629:                         0.0
630:                     } else if skill.is_trained() {
631:                         candidate + transferred.min(candidate)
632:                     } else {
633:                         candidate + transferred
634:                     }
635:                 },
636:             ))
637:         }
638:     }
639: }

43: fn apply_activity_outcomes_inner(

52:     let Some(settlement_id) = location.origin_settlement_id.as_ref() else {
53:         return Ok(ActivityRisks::default());
54:     };

56:         .db
57:         .settlement()

65:         .find(character_id)
66:         .ok_or("Character attributes not found")?;
67:     let limbs = ctx
68:         .db
69:         .character_limbs()
70:         .character_id()
71:         .find(character_id)
72:         .ok_or("Character limbs not found")?;
73:     let skills = ctx

75:         .character_skills()

97:         &equipment,

99:     );

101:     let population = adventuresim_core::activity::settlement_population_scale(

139:             character_id,

141:             "criminal_activity",
142:             &interval_end_minute.to_string(),
143:             0,
144:             (outcome.infamy_gained * 100.0).round() as i32,
145:             interval_end_minute,
146:         )?;
147:     }
148:     if apply_leisure {
149:         crate::condition::apply_settlement_leisure_condition(
150:             ctx,
151:             character_id,
152:             core_schedule(schedule),
153:             elapsed,
154:             interval_end_minute,

156:         crate::relationship::apply_spouse_leisure_conception(
157:             ctx,
158:             character_id,

170:                     crate::personality::Temperance::Drunkard => 3.0,
171:                     crate::personality::Temperance::Temperate => 0.35,
172:                     crate::personality::Temperance::Neutral => 1.0,
173:                 };

372: fn apply_organization_outcomes(
373:     ctx: &ReducerContext,
374:     character_id: u64,
375:     schedule: &ScheduleAllocation,
376:     elapsed: u64,
377:     settlement_id: &str,
378: ) -> Result<(), String> {
379:     if schedule.apprenticeship_minutes > 0 {
380:         let organization_id = schedule
381:             .apprenticeship_organization_id
382:             .as_deref()
383:             .ok_or("Apprenticeship time requires an organization")?;
384:         crate::organization::increment_activity_accrual(
385:             ctx,
386:             character_id,
387:             organization_id,
388:             elapsed.saturating_mul(u64::from(schedule.apprenticeship_minutes)),
389:             0,
390:         );
391:     }
392:     if schedule.profession_practice_minutes > 0 {
393:         let organization_id = schedule
394:             .practice_organization_id
395:             .as_deref()
396:             .ok_or("Professional practice time requires an organization")?;
397:         let mut row = crate::organization::membership(ctx, character_id, organization_id)
398:             .ok_or("Eligible organization membership disappeared during the interval")?;
399:         let definition = adventuresim_core::organization::organization(organization_id)
400:             .ok_or("Unknown organization")?;
401:         let role = crate::organization::membership_role(ctx, &row)?;
402:         let old = row.practice_minutes_accrued;
403:         row.practice_minutes_accrued = old.saturating_add(
404:             elapsed.saturating_mul(u64::from(schedule.profession_practice_minutes)),
405:         );
406:         let interval =
407:             u64::from(role.practice_reward_interval_minutes).saturating_mul(ACTIVITY_MINUTE_SCALE);
408:         if interval == 0 {
409:             return Err("Eligible organization role has no practice reward cadence".into());
410:         }
411:         let reward = row.practice_minutes_accrued / interval - old / interval;
412:         match definition.activity.reward {
413:             adventuresim_core::organization::ActivityReward::Gold if reward > 0 => {
414:                 crate::item::credit_personal_currency(
415:                     ctx,
416:                     character_id,
417:                     settlement_id,
418:                     u32::try_from(reward).unwrap_or(u32::MAX),
419:                 )?;
420:             }
421:             adventuresim_core::organization::ActivityReward::Fame if reward > 0 => {
422:                 let minute = ctx
423:                     .db
424:                     .character_time()
425:                     .character_id()
426:                     .find(character_id)
427:                     .map_or(StrategicMinute::ZERO, |t| t.minutes);
428:                 crate::reputation::record_event(
429:                     ctx,
430:                     format!("profession:{character_id}:{organization_id}:{minute}"),
431:                     character_id,
432:                     settlement_id,
433:                     "religious_practice",
434:                     organization_id,
435:                     i32::try_from(reward.saturating_mul(100)).unwrap_or(i32::MAX),
436:                     0,
437:                     minute,
438:                 )?;
439:             }
440:             _ => {}
441:         }
442:         ctx.db.organization_membership().id().update(row);
443:     }
444:     Ok(())
445: }

523: pub fn import_settlements(
524:     ctx: &ReducerContext,
525:     settlements: Vec<SettlementImport>,
526: ) -> Result<(), String> {
527:     require_active_world_import(ctx)?;
528:     if settlements.is_empty() {
529:         return Err("Settlement batch is empty".into());
530:     }
531:     for settlement in settlements {
532:         let elevation = ElevationMeters::new(settlement.elevation.get()).ok_or_else(|| {
533:             format!(
534:                 "Settlement {} has elevation outside the supported range",
535:                 settlement.id
536:             )
537:         })?;
538:         let land_use = LandUseProfile::new(
539:             settlement.land_use.cropland(),
540:             settlement.land_use.grazing(),
541:             settlement.land_use.built_up(),
542:             settlement.land_use.natural(),
543:         )
544:         .ok_or_else(|| {
545:             format!(
546:                 "Settlement {} has invalid land-use fractions",
547:                 settlement.id
548:             )
549:         })?;
550:         let forest_cover = match settlement.forest_cover {
551:             ForestCover::Open => ForestCover::Open,
552:             ForestCover::Wooded(woodland) => ForestCover::Wooded(Woodland {
553:                 density: CanopyDensity::new(woodland.density.percent()).ok_or_else(|| {
554:                     format!("Settlement {} has invalid canopy density", settlement.id)
555:                 })?,
556:                 dominant: woodland.dominant,
557:             }),
558:         };
559:         let potential_vegetation = settlement.potential_vegetation;
560:         let historical_vegetation = settlement.historical_vegetation;
561:         let tree_species = match settlement.tree_species {
562:             TreeSpeciesProfile::Modeled(profile) => {
563:                 let candidates = profile
564:                     .candidates()
565:                     .iter()
566:                     .map(|candidate| {
567:                         Ok(ModeledTreeSpecies {
568:                             species: TreeSpeciesId::new(candidate.species.as_str().to_owned())
569:                                 .ok_or_else(|| {
570:                                     format!(
571:                                         "Settlement {} has an invalid tree species",
572:                                         settlement.id
573:                                     )
574:                                 })?,
575:                             suitability: HabitatSuitability::new(candidate.suitability.score())
576:                                 .ok_or_else(|| {
577:                                     format!(
578:                                         "Settlement {} has invalid tree suitability",
579:                                         settlement.id
580:                                     )
581:                                 })?,
582:                             native_range: candidate.native_range,
583:                         })
584:                     })
585:                     .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, String>>()?;
586:                 TreeSpeciesProfile::Modeled(ModeledTreeSpeciesProfile::new(candidates).ok_or_else(
587:                     || {
588:                         format!(
589:                             "Settlement {} has an invalid modeled tree profile",
590:                             settlement.id
591:                         )
592:                     },
593:                 )?)
594:             }
595:             TreeSpeciesProfile::Inferred(profile) => {
596:                 let species = profile
597:                     .species()
598:                     .iter()
599:                     .map(|species| {
600:                         TreeSpeciesId::new(species.as_str().to_owned()).ok_or_else(|| {
601:                             format!("Settlement {} has an invalid tree species", settlement.id)
602:                         })
603:                     })
604:                     .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, String>>()?;
605:                 TreeSpeciesProfile::Inferred(InferredTreeSpeciesProfile::new(species).ok_or_else(
606:                     || {
607:                         format!(
608:                             "Settlement {} has an invalid inferred tree profile",
609:                             settlement.id
610:                         )
611:                     },
612:                 )?)
613:             }
614:         };
615:         let soil = reconstruct_soil_profile(&settlement.id, settlement.soil)?;
616:         let geology = reconstruct_geology_profile(&settlement.id, settlement.geology)?;
617:         let drought = reconstruct_drought_profile(&settlement.id, settlement.drought)?;
618:         validate_settlement_hydrology(&settlement.id, settlement.hydrology)?;
619:         settlement.industries.validate().map_err(|reason| {
620:             format!(
621:                 "Settlement {} has invalid industries: {reason}",
622:                 settlement.id
623:             )
624:         })?;
625:         if !adventuresim_world_schema::coordinates_in_bounds(
626:             settlement.longitude,
627:             settlement.latitude,
628:             adventuresim_world_schema::PLAYABLE_BOUNDS,
629:         ) || !settlement.languages.is_valid()
630:             || adventuresim_world_schema::infer_settlement_language_profile(
631:                 settlement.longitude,
632:                 settlement.latitude,
633:             )
634:             .ok()
635:                 != Some(settlement.languages)
636:         {
637:             return Err(format!(
638:                 "Settlement {} has an invalid language profile",
639:                 settlement.id
640:             ));
641:         }
642:         settlement.economy.validate().map_err(|reason| {
643:             format!("Settlement {} has invalid economy: {reason}", settlement.id)
644:         })?;
645:         // Route batches are resumable and may arrive before or after settlement
646:         // batches. Exact industry/profile equality is therefore checked against
647:         // the final edge table by `finish_world_data_import`.
648:         if !historical_vegetation_matches_context(
649:             historical_vegetation,
650:             land_use,
651:             &potential_vegetation,
652:             soil,
653:             settlement.hydrology,
654:         ) {
655:             return Err(format!(
656:                 "Settlement {} has historical vegetation inconsistent with its evidence",
657:                 settlement.id
658:             ));
659:         }
660:         if !valid_sources_markdown(&settlement.sources) {
661:             return Err(format!(
662:                 "Settlement {} has invalid source notes",
663:                 settlement.id
664:             ));
665:         }
666:         if !adventuresim_world_schema::valid_settlement_name(&settlement.name) {
667:             return Err(format!("Settlement {} has an invalid name", settlement.id));
668:         }
669:         if ctx
670:             .db
671:             .world_node()
672:             .id()
673:             .find(settlement.source_node_id)
674:             .is_none()
675:         {
676:             return Err(format!(
677:                 "Settlement {} references an unknown world node",
678:                 settlement.id
679:             ));
680:         }
681:         let currency_id = crate::item::settlement_currency_id(&settlement.id).to_string();
682:         let row = Settlement {
683:             id: settlement.id,
684:             name: settlement.name,
685:             coord_x: settlement.longitude,
686:             coord_y: settlement.latitude,
687:             population_level: settlement.population_level,
688:             population_estimate: settlement.population_estimate,
689:             category: settlement_category(
690:                 settlement.population_estimate,
691:                 settlement.population_level,
692:             ),
693:             elevation,
694:             land_use,
695:             forest_cover,
696:             potential_vegetation,
697:             historical_vegetation,
698:             tree_species,
699:             soil,
700:             geology,
701:             scene_key: settlement.scene_key,
702:             religion_id: settlement.religious_status.church().religion_id().into(),
703:             currency_id,
704:             religious_status: settlement.religious_status,
705:             languages: settlement.languages,
706:             drought,
707:             hydrology: settlement.hydrology,
708:             industries: settlement.industries,
709:             economy: settlement.economy,
710:             source_node_id: Some(settlement.source_node_id),
711:             sources: settlement.sources,
712:         };
713:         if ctx.db.settlement().id().find(&row.id).is_some() {
714:             ctx.db.settlement().id().update(row);
715:         } else {
716:             ctx.db.settlement().insert(row);
717:         }
718:     }
719:     Ok(())
720: }

220: pub fn backend_contracts(ctx: &ViewContext) -> Vec<BackendContract> {
221:     if !strategic_view_is_gateway(ctx) {
222:         return Vec::new();
223:     }
224:     ctx.db
225:         .contract_authority()
226:         .gateway_bucket()
227:         .filter(0u8)
228:         .filter_map(|row| {
229:             let sites = ctx
230:                 .db
231:                 .case_site_authority()
232:                 .case_id()
233:                 .filter(&row.case_id)
234:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>();
235:             let distance_m = sites.iter().map(|site| site.distance_m).max()?;
236:             let hostile_groups = sites
237:                 .iter()
238:                 .filter_map(|site| {
239:                     ctx.db
240:                         .hostile_group_authority()
241:                         .case_site_id_key()
242:                         .find(site.id.to_string())
243:                         .filter(|group| {
244:                             crate::investigation::canonical_case_site_place(&group.case_site_id_key)
245:                                 .map(|key_place| (key_place, group.case_site_id.to_place()))
246:                                 .is_some_and(|(key_place, typed_place)| key_place == typed_place)
247:                                 && group.case_site_id == site.id
248:                         })
249:                 })
250:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>();
251:             let (opposition_count, opposition_combat_power) = hostile_groups
252:                 .into_iter()
253:                 .map(|group| {
254:                     autoresolve_enemy(
255:                         u64::MAX,
256:                         &group.enemy_type,
257:                         group.base_difficulty,
258:                         group.combat_scale_bps,
259:                     )
260:                     .ok()
261:                     .and_then(|enemy| {
262:                         adventuresim_core::autoresolve::autoresolve_combat_power(&enemy)
263:                             .checked_mul(u64::from(group.enemy_count))
264:                     })
265:                     .map(|power| (group.enemy_count, power))
266:                 })
267:                 .try_fold((0u32, 0u64), |(count, total), group| {
268:                     let (group_count, power) = group?;
269:                     Some((count.checked_add(group_count)?, total.checked_add(power)?))
270:                 })?;

2: """Build the tactical WebAssembly client and synchronize browser assets."""
3: 
4: from __future__ import annotations
5: 
6: import argparse
7: import gzip
8: import json
9: from pathlib import Path
10: import shutil
11: import subprocess
12: import sys
13: import time
14: import tomllib
15: 
16: 
17: ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
18: STATIC_DIR = ROOT / "crates" / "adventuresim-stdb-module" / "static"
19: WASM_DIR = STATIC_DIR / "wasm"
20: ASSET_DIR = STATIC_DIR / "assets"
21: WASM_OPT_VERSION = "123"
22: 
23: 
24: def run(command: list[str], *, check: bool = True) -> int:
25:     result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT)
26:     if check and result.returncode:
27:         raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(result.returncode, command)
28:     return result.returncode
29: 
30: 
31: def sync_assets() -> None:
32:     if ASSET_DIR.exists():
33:         shutil.rmtree(ASSET_DIR)
34:     shutil.copytree(ROOT / "assets", ASSET_DIR)
35:     for source in (ROOT / "crates").glob("*/assets"):
36:         if source.is_dir():
37:             shutil.copytree(source, ASSET_DIR, dirs_exist_ok=True)
38: 
39: 
40: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
41:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
42:     parser.add_argument("--bindgen", default="wasm-bindgen",
43:                         help="Path to the wasm-bindgen CLI matching Cargo.lock")
44:     parser.add_argument("--wasm-opt", default=str(ROOT / "node_modules" / ".bin" / "wasm-opt"),
45:                         help=f"Path to wasm-opt version {WASM_OPT_VERSION}")
46:     parser.add_argument("--keep-name-section", action="store_true",
47:                         help="Keep wasm function names for readable panic traces")
48:     args = parser.parse_args(argv)
49:     lock = tomllib.loads((ROOT / "Cargo.lock").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
50:     expected = next(p["version"] for p in lock["package"] if p["name"] == "wasm-bindgen")
51:     wasm_bindgen = shutil.which(args.bindgen)
52:     if wasm_bindgen is None:
53:         print(f"Missing wasm-bindgen. Install wasm-bindgen-cli --version {expected}",
54:               file=sys.stderr)
55:         return 1
56:     wasm_opt = shutil.which(args.wasm_opt)
57:     if wasm_opt is None:
58:         print("Missing pinned wasm-opt. Run npm ci.", file=sys.stderr)
59:         return 1
60:     try:
61:         actual = subprocess.check_output([wasm_bindgen, "--version"], text=True).strip().split()[-1]
62:         if actual != expected:
63:             print(f"wasm-bindgen CLI {actual} does not match Rust {expected}. "
64:                   f"Install wasm-bindgen-cli --version {expected}, or pass --bindgen PATH.",
65:                   file=sys.stderr)
66:             return 1
67:         wasm_opt_version = subprocess.check_output(
68:             [wasm_opt, "--version"], text=True
69:         ).strip().split()[2]
70:         if wasm_opt_version != WASM_OPT_VERSION:
71:             print(f"wasm-opt {wasm_opt_version} does not match pinned "
72:                   f"version {WASM_OPT_VERSION}. Run npm ci.", file=sys.stderr)
73:             return 1
74:         print("Building WASM client...")
75:         if shutil.which("rustup"):
76:             run(["rustup", "target", "add", "wasm32-unknown-unknown"], check=False)
77:         started = time.perf_counter()
78:         common = ["cargo", "build", "--package", "adventuresim-tactical-client",
79:                   "--target", "wasm32-unknown-unknown"]
80:         # Preserve the ordinary tactical client's release build exactly. Build
81:         # the demo separately so Cargo cannot unify gameplay-only features into
82:         # its size-oriented binary.
83:         run([*common, "--bin", "adventuresim-tactical-client", "--release"])
84:         run([*common, "--bin", "art-demo", "--profile", "wasm-release",
85:              "--no-default-features"])
86:         build_seconds = time.perf_counter() - started
87:         WASM_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
88:         print("Generating JS bindings...")
89:         for binary in ("adventuresim-tactical-client", "art-demo"):
90:             profile = "wasm-release" if binary == "art-demo" else "release"
91:             source = (ROOT / "target" / "wasm32-unknown-unknown" /
92:                       profile / f"{binary}.wasm")
93:             bindgen = [
94:                 wasm_bindgen, "--out-dir", str(WASM_DIR), "--target", "web", "--no-typescript",
95:             ]
96:             if not args.keep_name_section:
97:                 bindgen.extend(["--remove-name-section", "--remove-producers-section"])
98:             run([*bindgen, str(source)])
99:             if binary == "art-demo":
100:                 generated = WASM_DIR / "art-demo_bg.wasm"
101:                 optimized = generated.with_stem("art-demo_bg-optimized")
102:                 run([wasm_opt, "--all-features", "-Oz", "--strip-debug",
103:                      "--strip-producers",
104:                      str(generated), "-o", str(optimized)])
105:                 optimized.replace(generated)
106:         print("Syncing browser assets...")
107:         sync_assets()
108:     except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
109:         print(error, file=sys.stderr)
110:         return 1
111:     print(f"WASM built to {WASM_DIR}")
112:     for path in sorted(WASM_DIR.iterdir()):
113:         print(f"  {path.name}: {path.stat().st_size} bytes")
114:     sizes = {"build_seconds": round(build_seconds, 3), "bundles": {}}
115:     for path in sorted(WASM_DIR.glob("*_bg.wasm")):
116:         data = path.read_bytes()
117:         brotli_data = subprocess.check_output([
118:             "node", "-e",
119:             "const fs=require('fs'),z=require('zlib');process.stdout.write("
120:             "z.brotliCompressSync(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1]),{params:{"
121:             "[z.constants.BROTLI_PARAM_QUALITY]:11}}))",
122:             str(path),
123:         ])
124:         sizes["bundles"][path.name] = {
125:             "raw_bytes": len(data),
126:             "gzip_bytes": len(gzip.compress(data, compresslevel=6, mtime=0)),
127:             "brotli_bytes": len(brotli_data),
128:         }
129:     report = WASM_DIR / "bundle-sizes.json"
130:     report.write_text(json.dumps(sizes, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
131:     print(f"  {report.name}: raw/gzip-6/brotli-11 measurements")
132:     return 0
133: 
134: 
135: if __name__ == "__main__":
136:     raise SystemExit(main())

332: fn validate_tier(name: &str, tier: &GrassTierConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
333:     let ordered = tier.fade_in_m[0] <= tier.fade_in_m[1]
334:         && tier.fade_in_m[1] <= tier.fade_out_m[0]
335:         && tier.fade_out_m[0] <= tier.fade_out_m[1];
336:     if !ordered
337:         || tier
338:             .fade_in_m
339:             .iter()
340:             .chain(tier.fade_out_m.iter())
341:             .any(|value| !value.is_finite() || *value < 0.0)
342:     {
343:         return Err(format!(
344:             "grass.lod.{name} fade distances must be finite, nonnegative, and ordered"
345:         ));
346:     }
347:     if tier.ribbon_rows.len() < 2
348:         || tier.ribbon_rows.first() != Some(&0.0)
349:         || tier
350:             .ribbon_rows
351:             .iter()
352:             .any(|value| !value.is_finite() || !(0.0..1.0).contains(value))
353:         || tier.ribbon_rows.windows(2).any(|pair| pair[0] >= pair[1])
354:     {
355:         return Err(format!(
356:             "grass.lod.{name}.ribbon_rows must be an increasing list from 0.0 to below 1.0"
357:         ));
358:     }
359:     if tier.native_tufts_per_cell_side == 0 || tier.native_blades_per_tuft_side == 0 {
360:         return Err(format!(
361:             "grass.lod.{name} native topology dimensions must be nonzero"
362:         ));
363:     }
364:     if tier
365:         .root_stratum_side
366:         .is_some_and(|side| side == 0 || side > 32 || 32 % side != 0)

342: fn validate_tier(name: &str, tier: &GrassTierConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
343:     let ordered = tier.fade_in_m[0] <= tier.fade_in_m[1]
344:         && tier.fade_in_m[1] <= tier.fade_out_m[0]
345:         && tier.fade_out_m[0] <= tier.fade_out_m[1];
346:     if !ordered
347:         || tier
348:             .fade_in_m
349:             .iter()
350:             .chain(tier.fade_out_m.iter())
351:             .any(|value| !value.is_finite() || *value < 0.0)
352:     {
353:         return Err(format!(
354:             "grass.lod.{name} fade distances must be finite, nonnegative, and ordered"
355:         ));
356:     }
357:     if tier.ribbon_rows.len() < 2
358:         || tier.ribbon_rows.first() != Some(&0.0)
359:         || tier
360:             .ribbon_rows
361:             .iter()
362:             .any(|value| !value.is_finite() || !(0.0..1.0).contains(value))
363:         || tier.ribbon_rows.windows(2).any(|pair| pair[0] >= pair[1])
364:     {
365:         return Err(format!(
366:             "grass.lod.{name}.ribbon_rows must be an increasing list from 0.0 to below 1.0"
367:         ));
368:     }
369:     if tier.native_tufts_per_cell_side == 0 || tier.native_blades_per_tuft_side == 0 {
370:         return Err(format!(
371:             "grass.lod.{name} native topology dimensions must be nonzero"
372:         ));
373:     }
374:     if tier
375:         .root_stratum_side
376:         .is_some_and(|side| side == 0 || side > 32 || 32 % side != 0)
377:     {
378:         return Err(format!(
379:             "grass.lod.{name}.root_stratum_side must divide the 32-root patch grid"
380:         ));
381:     }
382:     Ok(())
383: }

1: //! Distance and frustum culling of character pose evaluation.
2: //!
3: //! A rig that leaves the cull distance or the camera frustum stops being
4: //! advanced, and `apply_pose_buffers` stops writing it. The procedural passes
5: //! downstream share that decision through [`PoseCulled`] so an off-screen
6: //! character is filtered out of their queries rather than being solved for a
7: //! pose nothing can see.
8: 
9: use bevy::prelude::*;
10: 
11: use super::{PoseBufferMetrics, PoseBufferRig, PoseVisibility};
12: 
13: /// Marks a character whose pose evaluation was culled.
14: #[derive(Component)]
15: pub(in crate::animation) struct PoseCulled;
16: 
17: /// Applies this frame's cull decision to `rig`, maintaining [`PoseCulled`]
18: /// alongside the rig's own visibility. Returns `culled`.
19: pub(super) fn cull_pose_rig(
20:     rig: &mut PoseBufferRig,
21:     owner: Entity,
22:     culled: bool,
23:     commands: &mut Commands<'_, '_>,
24:     metrics: &mut PoseBufferMetrics,
25: ) -> bool {
26:     if culled {
27:         rig.visibility = PoseVisibility::Frozen;
28:         commands.entity(owner).insert(PoseCulled);
29:         metrics.culled_character_count += 1;
30:         return true;
31:     }
32:     if rig.visibility == PoseVisibility::Frozen {
33:         commands.entity(owner).remove::<PoseCulled>();
34:     }
35:     rig.resume_visible_sampling();
36:     false
37: }

5: pub(super) fn sync_procedural_equipment_skins(
6:     mut commands: Commands,
7:     parts: Query<(Entity, &ProceduralEquipmentPart, Option<&SkinnedMesh>)>,
8:     items: Query<(Option<&ItemOf>, Option<&EquipSlot>, Has<TacticalSceneItem>)>,
9:     bones: Query<(Entity, &MhrBone, &AuthoredRigJoint)>,
10: ) {
11:     let mut rig_bones = HashMap::<Entity, HashMap<RigJointName, Entity>>::new();
12:     for (entity, bone, name) in &bones {
13:         rig_bones
14:             .entry(bone.owner)
15:             .or_default()
16:             .insert(name.name().clone(), entity);
17:     }
18:     for (entity, part, current_skin) in &parts {
19:         let desired_joints = items
20:             .get(part.item)
21:             .ok()
22:             .and_then(|(owner, slot, scene)| {
23:                 (!scene && holding_side(slot).is_none()).then_some(owner?.0)
24:             })
25:             .and_then(|owner| {
26:                 let bones = rig_bones.get(&owner)?;
27:                 part.joint_names
28:                     .iter()
29:                     .map(|name| bones.get(name).copied())
30:                     .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()
31:             });
32:         if let Some(joints) = desired_joints {
33:             if current_skin.is_none_or(|skin| skin.joints != joints) {
34:                 commands.entity(entity).insert(SkinnedMesh {
35:                     inverse_bindposes: part.inverse_bindposes.clone(),
36:                     joints,
37:                 });
38:             }
39:         } else if current_skin.is_some() {
40:             commands.entity(entity).remove::<SkinnedMesh>();
41:         }
42:     }
43: }

5: pub(super) fn sync_procedural_equipment_skins(
6:     mut commands: Commands,
7:     parts: Query<(Entity, &ProceduralEquipmentPart, Option<&SkinnedMesh>)>,
8:     items: Query<(Option<&ItemOf>, Option<&EquipSlot>, Has<TacticalSceneItem>)>,
9:     bones: Query<(Entity, &MhrBone, &AuthoredRigJoint)>,
10: ) {
11:     if parts.is_empty() {
12:         return;
13:     }
14:     // Borrow the joint names rather than owning them: this index is rebuilt every
15:     // frame, and cloning each name cost one heap allocation per bone per rig.
16:     let mut rig_bones = HashMap::<Entity, HashMap<&RigJointName, Entity>>::new();
17:     for (entity, bone, name) in &bones {
18:         rig_bones
19:             .entry(bone.owner)
20:             .or_default()
21:             .insert(name.name(), entity);
22:     }
23:     for (entity, part, current_skin) in &parts {
24:         let desired_joints = items
25:             .get(part.item)
26:             .ok()
27:             .and_then(|(owner, slot, scene)| {
28:                 (!scene && holding_side(slot).is_none()).then_some(owner?.0)
29:             })
30:             .and_then(|owner| {
31:                 let bones = rig_bones.get(&owner)?;
32:                 part.joint_names
33:                     .iter()
34:                     .map(|name| bones.get(name).copied())
35:                     .collect::<Option<Vec<_>>>()
36:             });
37:         if let Some(joints) = desired_joints {
38:             if current_skin.is_none_or(|skin| skin.joints != joints) {
39:                 commands.entity(entity).insert(SkinnedMesh {
40:                     inverse_bindposes: part.inverse_bindposes.clone(),
41:                     joints,
42:                 });
43:             }
44:         } else if current_skin.is_some() {
45:             commands.entity(entity).remove::<SkinnedMesh>();
46:         }
47:     }
48: }

126: impl QuickstepContactHandoff {
127:     pub(super) fn is_pending(self) -> bool {
128:         matches!(self, Self::Converging { .. })
129:     }
130: 
131:     pub(super) fn is_held(self) -> bool {
132:         matches!(self, Self::Held { .. })
133:     }
134: 
135:     pub(super) fn targets(self) -> Option<(Vec3, Vec3)> {
136:         match self {
137:             Self::None => None,
138:             Self::Converging { left, right } | Self::Held { left, right } => Some((left, right)),
139:         }
140:     }
141: 
142:     pub(super) fn update_targets(&mut self, left: Vec3, right: Vec3) {
143:         *self = match self {
144:             Self::Converging { .. } => Self::Converging { left, right },
145:             Self::Held { .. } => Self::Held { left, right },
146:             Self::None => Self::None,
147:         };
148:     }
149: 
150:     pub(super) fn hold(&mut self) {
151:         if let Self::Converging { left, right } = *self {
152:             *self = Self::Held { left, right };
153:         }
154:     }
155: }

160:     left_world: Vec3,
161:     right_world: Vec3,
162: ) -> bool {
163:     if !left_world.is_finite() || !right_world.is_finite() {
164:         return false;
165:     }
166:     let (rig_origin, rig_rotation) = (frame.origin(), frame.rotation());
167:     let inverse_rotation = rig_rotation.inverse();
168:     let left = inverse_rotation * (left_world - rig_origin);
169:     let right = inverse_rotation * (right_world - rig_origin);
170:     if !left.is_finite() || !right.is_finite() {
171:         return false;
172:     }
173:     memory.quickstep_handoff = QuickstepContactHandoff::Converging { left, right };
174:     memory.owner_frame = Some(frame);
175:     true

346: fn understory_scatter_chance(canopy: f32, wetland: f32, cultivation: f32) -> f32 {
347:     // This is intentionally about 70% below the original physical-shrub
348:     // occupancy. Community multipliers retain dense, readable clumps rather
349:     // than turning the reduced population into evenly spaced specimens.
350:     (canopy * 0.156 + wetland * 0.09 + cultivation * 0.024).clamp(0.0, 0.075)
351: }
352: 
353: pub(in crate::presentation) fn grass_scatter_density(
354:     canopy: f32,
355:     water: f32,
356:     cultivation: f32,
357:     snow: f32,
358: ) -> f32 {
359:     // Deep shade and standing water should expose litter, mud, and hummocks;
360:     // a quarter-density floor still read as an implausible meadow and made
361:     // woodland traversal a wall of overlapping rectangular blade ribbons.
362:     (0.98 - canopy * 0.95 - water * 0.88 + cultivation * 0.04).clamp(0.08, 0.98)
363:         * (1.0 - snow * 1.25).clamp(0.12, 1.0)
364: }

366: pub(in crate::presentation) fn grass_pigment(environment: &SceneEnvironment) -> (Color, f32) {
367:     let grass_dryness = (1.0
368:         - bps(environment.weather.ground_moisture_bps) * 0.7
369:         - bps(environment.canopy_bps) * 1.2
370:         - bps(environment.wetland_bps) * 0.8
371:         - bps(environment.water_bps) * 0.8)
372:         .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
373:     let color = if environment.weather.snow_cover_bps >= 5_000 {
374:         Color::srgb_u8(155, 164, 137)
375:     } else if environment.cultivation_bps >= 4_000 {
376:         Color::srgb_u8(142, 133, 61)
377:     } else {
378:         // Blend pigment in sRGB authoring space from hydrated chlorophyll to
379:         // a dry olive sward. Fine-grained cohort variation remains in the
380:         // shader, but the biome-wide baseline honors replicated moisture and
381:         // shade instead of rendering dry grassland as woodland green.
382:         let hydrated = Vec3::new(82.0, 119.0, 45.0);
383:         let senescent = Vec3::new(150.0, 126.0, 52.0);
384:         let pigment = hydrated.lerp(senescent, grass_dryness * 0.78);
385:         Color::srgb_u8(pigment.x as u8, pigment.y as u8, pigment.z as u8)
386:     };
387:     (color, grass_dryness)
388: }

390: /// Solid-ground albedo that reproduces the *rendered* optical mass of the
391: /// procedural sward. Blade vertex pigments are subsequently darkened by the
392: /// species/cohort palette, root occlusion, rib occlusion, and thin-foliage
393: /// lighting, so copying their input pigment directly makes upward-facing
394: /// terrain much brighter than the grass it replaces.
395: pub(in crate::presentation) fn grass_terminal_pigment(environment: &SceneEnvironment) -> Color {
396:     let linear = grass_pigment(environment).0.to_linear().to_f32_array();

398:         linear[0] * 0.34,
399:         linear[1] * 0.38,
400:         linear[2] * 0.18,
401:         1.0,
402:     ))
403: }

351: mod tests {
352:     use std::{fs, path::Path};
353: 
354:     /// WGSL requires every directive to precede the first declaration, and an
355:     /// `#import` expands into declarations. A directive written below the
356:     /// imports fails composition for the whole file, which surfaces only as a
357:     /// log line while the material stops rendering on every backend.
358:     #[test]
359:     fn shader_directives_precede_declarations() {
360:         // Both shader roots the tactical renderer composes: the runtime asset
361:         // directory and the shaders embedded in the procedural materials crate.
362:         const SHADER_ROOTS: [&str; 2] = [
363:             concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../../assets/shaders"),
364:             concat!(
365:                 env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"),
366:                 "/../adventuresim-procedural-materials/src/shaders"
367:             ),
368:         ];
369:         let mut checked = 0;
370:         for root in SHADER_ROOTS {
371:             for entry in fs::read_dir(Path::new(root)).expect("tactical shader directory") {
372:                 let path = entry.expect("shader directory entry").path();
373:                 if path.extension().is_none_or(|extension| extension != "wgsl") {
374:                     continue;
375:                 }
376:                 let source = fs::read_to_string(&path).expect("readable tactical shader");
377:                 assert_directives_precede_declarations(&path.display().to_string(), &source);
378:                 checked += 1;
379:             }
380:         }
381:         assert!(checked > 0, "no tactical shaders were checked");
382:     }
383: 
384:     fn assert_directives_precede_declarations(label: &str, source: &str) {
385:         let mut declared = false;
386:         for (index, line) in source.lines().enumerate() {
387:             let line = line.trim();
388:             if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with("//") {
389:                 continue;
390:             }
391:             if line.starts_with("diagnostic(")
392:                 || line.starts_with("enable ")
393:                 || line.starts_with("requires ")
394:             {
395:                 assert!(
396:                     !declared,
397:                     "{label}:{}: WGSL directive written after a declaration; \
398:                      move it above the imports or the shader will not compile",
399:                     index + 1
400:                 );
401:             } else if !line.starts_with('#') || line.starts_with("#import") {
402:                 declared = true;
403:             }
404:         }
405:     }
406: }
